notes.title: World update is now out!
notes.notes:
[h1]World update is now out![/h1]

[h2]What's new with this update?[/h2]
[list]
[*]10 new maps
[*]50+ new skins
[*]Improved surfing mechanics
[*]New maps have an animated skybox!
[/list]


[h2]New maps[/h2]
[h3]Bhop[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Egypt map
[*]UAE map
[*]China map
[*]France map
[*] the Netherlands
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/f45adbde239022fcf69b2f82ca882241fd50e822.png[/img]
[h3]Surf[/h3]
[olist]
[*] the Alps, Italy map
[*]Antarctica map
[*]Turkey map
[*]USA map

[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/cc1952028810b0fd6d121666f1d580441b24d718.png[/img]
[h2]Improved surfing mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*]Surfing now feels better
[*]You don't lose much speed when switching ramps
[*]You gain more speed on ramps!
[/list]
[h2]Couple of the new skins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/e2e7db19726c7a8da458a72bcf9556af8503612c.png[/img]

notes.title: Update version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Leaderboard bugs:
[list]
[*] - Leaderboard didn't load if you didn't complete the level. Now it does load as it should.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] - Tab is highlighted blue to be more clear where you currently are.
[/list]

New Features:
- Click on anyone on the leaderboards and their profile will open!
Leaderboards should now work completely

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] - Your own time on the leaderboards wouldn't load correctly
[*] - Profile tab text fixed
[/olist]

[b]New feature:[/b]
[olist]
[*] - The leaderboards can now display up to 50 players with a scrollable field, instead of the old 8.
[/olist]

That's all for this update!
